overview: Gold Fever has been running strong for thirteen years and has a promising future ahead. Hosted by Tom Massie, Gold Fever remains one of the highest rated shows on Outdoor Channel, taking viewers on adventures all over the United States, and soon – the world. Shot in high definition, the show has captivated hundreds of thousands of people with its visually stunning photography. Gold Fever's success is derived from two core principles: education and entertainment. We work hard to teach the fundamentals of finding gold while at the same time making the show exciting for all viewers. Gold Fever is not your typical travel show, it is much larger than that. We take viewers in to some of the most remote locations in this country, showcasing the vast beauty of mother nature, and one of the gifts she provides... gold.

overview: A vibrant trip through Europe's natural beauty, rich biodiversity, and unique ecosystems. Explore the landscape of endless coasts, deep into ancient forests, high up in the mountains and along the frigid arctic circle. Frozen Wonderland: The deep snow of winter can bring hardships and life centers around surviving the bitter cold. Wolves and lynx hunt for their next meal, wolverines scavenge and mountain goats face an avalanche. A New Day: Spring and summer in Europe bring babies. From barnacle geese learning to fly from high cliffs in Greenland, to brown bears and great gray owls teaching their little ones about life in the forests.
title: Europe's Wild Places

overview: From traditional Irish stew to soda bread, fresh seafood, and boxty potato pancakes - Dermot will taste his way across the island, meeting the chefs and locals that champion and celebrate Ireland's gastronomic heritage. Having opened two of his own fish-themed restaurants and sharing some of his favourite home recipes on ITV's This Morning, he is now taking his passion on the road whilst exploring Ireland's ancient landscapes, diverse cities and stunning coastlines. From Michelin Star restaurants in the ‘Gourmet Capital of Ireland' Kinsale; to fishing for oysters by the sea in Cork; sitting down for some home-grown comfort food in Wexford; and exploring the buzz of the Dublin food scene; before venturing across to Northern Ireland and the bustling city of Belfast and beyond - Dermot's Taste of Ireland promises to be a foodie delight, full of surprises.
title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland

overview: Classic 1950s and 60s pop music show in which a panel votes hit or miss on the new releases they are played.

overview: Shot in high-definition, Alaska Outdoors TV – produced by 59th Parallel Productions Inc. – gives viewers an open window into Alaska's remote wilderness. Alaska's best outdoor enthusiasts team up to challenge rugged terrain and often-unforgiving conditions. Cameras follow these outdoor adventurists in each episode as they explore a variety of diverse hunting and fishing opportunities in Alaska's last frontier. "It has been a crazy season,"adds executive producer Tim Delarm. "A lot of amazing adventure was experienced and I'm really glad that I was personally there to witness places I have not been before and to capture it all on film. I'm still amazed, as an Alaskan, at the vast size and number of outdoor opportunities available to each and every one of us. I think the whole team pretty much feels that way; people are going to see this show and realize really how remote, untamed and rugged Alaska is."
title: Alaska Outdoors TV

The town has completely changed, and he vows to leave to begin a new life, but odd things keep happening to him and around him, preventing him from leaving.

overview: Reel in the Outdoors actually started as an idea several years ago. While there are plenty of great fishing shows on the tube, I wanted to do something different. I wanted to see why Americans absolutely and undeniably love fishing. So I set out, camera, microphone and a rough idea in hand, to find out what makes America so interested and intent on angling. What we found not only surprised us, it entertained us, too. Not only did we get a chance to spend time with some of the top anglers in the country on their favorite body of water, but we also got to meet people who are passionate about not only fishing, but their unique style of fishing. This season on Stihl's Reel in the Outdoors with Joe Thomas, I'll travel from Mexico to Alaska, fish farm ponds and streams, chase bass, king salmon, muskie, catfish and whatever else will bite, and try to pass along tips, hints and secrets I've learned from over 25 years on the pro tournament trail to help you enjoy angling more than ever before. And now you're wondering…why is a chainsaw company sponsoring a fishing show? Well, I've been fortunate enough to be associated with Stihl and Bryan Equipment Company, the Stihl distributor in my home region, for many years. The folks at Stihl get it. They understand that the same passion and desire that attracts people to angling also attracts them to the do-it-yourself spirit that Stihl embodies. Stihl didn't become the number one chainsaw manufacturer in the world by accident. It's hard work, dedication and a commitment to excellence that drives the Stihl brand. So visit your local Stihl dealer or their website. Let them know you support a company that supports your passion and the great outdoors.
title: Reel in the Outdoors

overview: Lucky Luke tells the story of the legendary, lonely cowboy who must help Louise, an eighteen-year-old girl as endearing as she is unpredictable. Together, they embark on a quest across the Wild West to find Louise's mother, who has mysteriously disappeared… while thwarting a plot that could change the course of U.S. history! Between duels, chases, furious balls and unexpected alliances with the Daltons, Billy the Kid or Calamity Jane, our unlikely duo will discover that the biggest challenge is not to save America… but to team up! A thrilling adventure where the man who shoots faster than his shadow will have to face the ghosts of his past and confront the origins of his legend.
title: Lucky Luke

overview: Following three series of the Merman-produced, BAFTA award-winning series Motherland, a brand-new spin-off, Amandaland, is coming to the BBC, focused on Amanda. Post her divorce, Amanda has had to downsize and up sticks to South Harlesden, or as the Estate Agent calls it SoHa (definitely not the area around Wormwood Scrubs prison). With both Manus and Georgie now at secondary school, Amanda has to try and get her head around raising teenagers, dealing with modern motherhood horrors like teenage drinking, fake Instagram accounts and eco anxiety. Not even a woman as certain of her parenting as Amanda can deal with these nightmares alone. Then there's Amanda's mother Felicity who is constantly around, and completely in denial that she is, in fact, lonely. Theirs is a slightly unhealthy co-dependent relationship based on backhanded compliments and veiled snipes about her new home. After a brief spell of freedom, Anne is sucked back into being Amanda's minion to help her navigate the social scene with the other parents at the children's new school. Thank God for Anne.
title: Amandaland

overview: A 999 call comes into the emergency services reporting a murder. Is it a traumatised witness who survived? A distressed loved one who finds the aftermath? Or is it the chilling voice of the killer? In this series we focus on shocking murder cases where the person who makes the call is actually the murderer. In each episode we unravel the sequence of events that lead up to the call and then the investigation that follows to determine the identity of the murderer and how they were caught. In every case the call is a key piece of evidence as the police piece together the case and get justice for the victim.
title: A Killer Makes a Call

overview: Host, Mike Rogers, takes viewers around the globe on this year's exciting 11th season of SCI Expedition Safari. Mike shares his adventures with good friends in Florida for the American Gator and then travels all the way around the world to hunt the much larger cousin in Namibia, the Nile Crocodile. See the differences in hunting methods and species on these exciting hunts. In South Africa, Mike joins fellow conservationists on an important mission to save a baby Rhino who was injured during a failed poaching attempt. Watch as Mike works with local veterinarians, outfitters, and anti-poaching units, as they dart baby and mama Rhino to care for them. Last season, Mike endured his most challenging hunt ever with a trip to the rugged mountains in the Yukon in search of the Dall Sheep. This season, Mike returns for a second attempt and succeeds on one of his toughest hunts yet. Expedition Safari takes you south of the border to enjoy the warm blue waters of the Sea of Cortez in Baja Mexico. With a spear gun, Mike hunts some of the most diverse fishing waters available on the planet. On this episode, he and his guide take the catch directly into the kitchen and show you some of the easiest ways to prepare fresh sashimi. Alaska Yukon Moose is the target for this trip up North. This beautiful wilderness offers amazing sights and challenging conditions. Mike then travels to Alaska in pursuit of exciting game, with good friend and SCI award-winning outfitter Sam Fejes. Outfitter Matt Cates, of Triple M Outfitting Unlimited and his son, join Mike on a blackbuck, antelope and axis deer hunt in Florida. Watch as the rich habitat in South Central Florida combine with a sound science-based conservation model to produce extraordinary antelope and deer. These and other exciting locations are on this season of SCI's Expedition Safari. SCI-Safari Club International - is known around the world as a leader in protecting the freedom to hunt and promoting wildlife conservation worldwide. Expedition Safari is our flagship series with Mike Rogers leading the way. With a passion for hunting and respect for nature and wildlife, Mike embodies these values. Conserving our rich hunting heritage nationally and internationally, SCI is First for Hunters!
title: SCI Expedition Safari

overview: Taishin has moved to Tokyo from his hometown of Fukuoka in order to reunite with Takara, a stranger who had consoled him in his grief the year prior. overview: SOLO Hunter in its raw form is the pure reality of hunting for an adventure and often times survival. By removing the element of production teams and cameramen, SOLO Hunter has eliminated the disconnect between hunter and viewer. You see the hunts as they do. You go with them as they hunt, kill, eat, sleep and survive in some of the world's most inclement weather and treacherous terrain. As hosts Tim Burnett and Remi Warren take you on a personalized and intimate adventure, the walls of personal comfort zones are broken down. Burnett and Warren take a non-traditional approach to documenting their adventures. Even though the filming is different, the way they hunt is very familiar to millions of hunters throughout the world. "On Your Own" and "Do It Yourself" are common phrases among hunters in taverns and man room's throughout the world – their desire is to show the experience of the hunt as it actually happens in a documentary SOLO film style – from the day you think of going on the hunt till the day you load your meat in the locker.
title: SOLO Hunter
